description: Seven colours of noise, each on its own output

outputs.text: White noise, equal in intensity at every frequency, each voltage drawn from a normal distribution
Pink noise, falling by -3dB per octave, so it carries more bass than white noise
Red noise, falling by -6dB per octave, so it carries more bass than pink noise
Violet noise, rising by +6dB per octave
Blue noise, rising by +3dB per octave
Gray noise, filtered to an equal-loudness curve so that it sounds even across the range of human hearing
Black noise, with each voltage drawn from a uniform distribution; it aliases, which suits sample and hold and other control uses rather than listening
